finalists.label: Dermatomyositis
finalists.why: The presence of a heliotrope rash, erythematous lip swelling, and skin biopsy results consistent with Wong-type presentation strongly support this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Inflammatory myopathy
finalists.why: Elevated creatine kinase and a positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies are specific findings that support this diagnosis.

frontier_selector.why: The specific skin manifestations and biopsy results in the vignette uniquely support Dermatomyositis over the more general diagnosis of Inflammatory myopathy.
